modules.name: Specification Layer
modules.responsibility: Freeze original request/reference interpretation before Loop; retain one Specification per Session
modules.inputs: Original request; exact Reference FileIdentity; resolved dialogue; criteria/applicability; envelope
modules.outputs: FrozenSpecification + adaptive contract projection pinned to specification identity
modules.owned_state: Frozen bytes and explicitly finalized authority fields
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence
modules.persistent_artifacts: Frozen Specification; dialogue evidence; adaptive specification contract
modules.focused_tests: Existing test_session_boundary + new contract projection tests

modules.name: Session Controller
modules.responsibility: Own one existing SessionBoundary and its adaptive trajectory
modules.inputs: Frozen Specification; immutable envelope; current reference; adapters
modules.owned_state: Session current run/attempt and monotonic execution ownership
modules.may_call: Public SessionBoundary methods; Production/Attempt Controller; Frontier; logging; acceptance
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; direct tool API; same-Session human approval
modules.persistent_artifacts: Existing Session binding; adaptive contract; terminal

modules.name: Frontier Supervisor
modules.responsibility: Obtain model inference for planning and next action, with observable invocation lineage
modules.inputs: Frozen Specification; Session/Run/Attempt; Workflow; artifacts/reviews; skills/capabilities; remaining envelope
modules.outputs: Frontier Decision Artifact with structured reason and selected action
modules.may_call: Injected inference adapter; validators; Skill/Workflow services via controller
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; direct Worker effect; manufacture Reviewer verdict
modules.persistent_artifacts: Frontier request; invocation; sanitized stream evidence; Decision Artifact
modules.focused_tests: test_frontier: context binding, mock boundary, invocation lineage

modules.name: Skill Artifact Layer
modules.responsibility: Version portable reusable guidance, metadata, immutable executable knowledge identity
modules.inputs: SKILL.md and supporting content; provenance/license review; dependency pins; capabilities
modules.outputs: CANDIDATE version; explicit actual-success validation evidence
modules.owned_state: Skill version/hash/VCS revision and validation records
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; automatic VALIDATED on synthetic PASS; direct Worker calls
modules.focused_tests: test_skill_artifact: hashes, version immutability, actual-only promotion

modules.name: Skill Registry / Discovery
modules.responsibility: Resolve local versions and composition; expose reviewed community-copy boundary
modules.inputs: Local registry; installed capability inventory; pinned community sources/review/license evidence
modules.outputs: Exact skill refs; admissible dependency order; discovery report
modules.owned_state: Registry candidates and provenance; no Session state
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; Session transitions; Worker; acceptance; execution of unreviewed community commands
modules.persistent_artifacts: Discovery/reuse report; local reviewed copy; source revision/license/review refs
modules.focused_tests: test_skill_registry: all four composition preflights and reviewed-copy rejection

modules.name: Workflow Planner
modules.responsibility: Validate a model-proposed compact sequential configuration against authority and installed capabilities
modules.inputs: Frozen contract; skill refs; capabilities; model proposal; current failure evidence for revision
modules.may_call: Skill Registry; Workflow Artifact; Event Logging
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; production execution; inventing missing user intent
modules.focused_tests: test_workflow_artifact: capability/applicability coverage and declaration boundaries

modules.name: Workflow Artifact / Instance
modules.responsibility: Pin stages, tools/models/skills, authority, version/hash and revision cause
modules.inputs: Planner configuration; Specification ref; exact Skill refs; source Review/Decision refs
modules.outputs: Immutable Workflow ref and stage definitions
modules.may_call: Artifact/hash validation; Skill Registry composition preflight
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; recursive retry representation; mutable historical versions
modules.persistent_artifacts: Workflow vN JSON with evidence-linked revision
modules.focused_tests: test_workflow_artifact: version pins and unchanged Specification

modules.name: Production Run Controller
modules.responsibility: Bind one Workflow version to a fresh Run; supersede old Run when strategy changes
modules.inputs: Validated Workflow; Frontier Decision; Session; collision preflight
modules.outputs: Fresh Production Run; preserved terminal/superseded old Run
modules.owned_state: Production Run identity, bound Workflow, terminal
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; promote another Run evidence silently; resume historical Run
modules.persistent_artifacts: Run contract; superseded/terminal record; restart cause
modules.focused_tests: test_adaptive_loop: restart, strategy binding, stale evidence

modules.name: Attempt Controller
modules.responsibility: Manage bounded local corrections under same Run/Workflow; reserve effects before dispatch
modules.inputs: Current Run; same-strategy Frontier action; resource envelope; adapter namespaces
modules.outputs: Fresh Attempt; work order; preserved previous attempt outcome
modules.owned_state: Attempt namespace and reservation/consumed effect slots
modules.may_call: Execution Adapter; Artifact Store; Reviewer routing; logging
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; change strategy in same Run; blind retry after unresolved effect
modules.persistent_artifacts: Attempt contract; work orders; reservations; result/outcome
modules.focused_tests: test_adaptive_loop: local Attempt vs strategy Run and reservation guards

modules.name: Artifact / Evidence Store
modules.responsibility: Retain every meaningful artifact and validate exact current lineage and hashes
modules.inputs: Produced files; source refs; Session/Run/Attempt; Workflow/Skill identities; producer/event
modules.outputs: Immutable Artifact refs and validated lineage
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; silent current promotion from another Run; acceptance judgment
modules.persistent_artifacts: Artifact metadata, generated/reference/diagnostic bytes, supporting execution reports
modules.focused_tests: test_adaptive_artifacts: content mutation, lineage mismatch, retained predecessors

modules.name: Reviewer Layer
modules.responsibility: Independently judge applicable frozen criteria for current artifact stage
modules.inputs: Applicable criteria; current artifact; supporting refs; authority context
modules.may_call: Injected semantic review adapter; evidence validation; logging
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; Workflow mutation; Worker; Attempt/Run restart
modules.persistent_artifacts: Stage Review request/result, invocation and stream evidence
modules.focused_tests: test_artifact_review: criterion coverage, current-source binding, no execution

modules.name: Diagnosis / Decision Layer
modules.responsibility: Bind next-action judgment to current Review, Artifact, and frozen authority
modules.inputs: Current Review/Artifact/lineage; Specification; current state; remaining envelope
modules.outputs: CONTINUE / REVISE_ARTIFACT / ACQUIRE_EVIDENCE / REVISE_WORKFLOW / RESTART_PRODUCTION_RUN / ACCEPT; justified terminal
modules.owned_state: Structured decision and evidence refs only
modules.may_call: Frontier inference adapter; deterministic invariant validation
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; artifact fabrication; verdict forgery; automatic REVISE-to-seed/restart rule
modules.persistent_artifacts: Decision + reason summary + cited evidence + selected action
modules.focused_tests: test_frontier + test_adaptive_loop: evidence-bound action and no hidden reasoning transcripts

modules.name: Execution Adapter Layer
modules.responsibility: Perform explicitly selected tool/API/CLI effects with tool-specific transport validation
modules.inputs: Reserved work order; exact input refs; selected installed tool/model; unique namespaces
modules.outputs: Artifact files + Execution Report + observable runtime evidence
modules.may_call: Existing Comfy executor, PNG/GLB validation, normalization, Blender diagnostic helpers; selected Worker/tool
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; alter Goal or criteria; download/delete model; automatic reuse/resume after failure
modules.persistent_artifacts: Command/API input; reservation; execution reports; generated/intermediate artifact bytes
modules.focused_tests: test_adaptive_adapter: injected effect-light calls, namespace/input checks

modules.name: Acceptance / Terminal Layer
modules.responsibility: Accept only complete mandatory criterion coverage from current valid lineage; preserve justified terminal failure
modules.inputs: Current Workflow/Run/Artifact/Review; acceptance criteria/applicability; Frontier ACCEPT
modules.may_call: Current-lineage validation; public SessionBoundary internal_accept/stop; Delivery Boundary
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; human-in-loop gate; stale Review authorization; semantic REVISE alone as terminal
modules.focused_tests: test_adaptive_loop: stale Review rejects, current full coverage accepts

modules.name: Delivery Boundary
modules.responsibility: Prepare exact accepted package, observe local submission/handoff record and close without human acknowledgement
modules.inputs: Current accepted package; locally verifiable handoff/submission evidence; intended boundary
modules.outputs: CLOSED terminal with delivery evidence and explicit observation limits
modules.owned_state: Delivery package/submission record; no user quality state
modules.may_call: Public accepted-package validation; file identity; local record
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; demand receipt token/user quality approval; reopen closed Session
modules.persistent_artifacts: Delivery package; local handoff record; terminal; late feedback stored outside trajectory
modules.focused_tests: test_session_boundary additive tests: no-human closure, package lineage, legacy receipt preserved

modules.name: Event Logging
modules.responsibility: Keep canonical module-local events and hash-bound global index with Session-local monotonic ordering
modules.inputs: Event envelope; causal parent; input/output refs; structured decision/reason
modules.outputs: Canonical event + event_index pointer; reconstructable chronology
modules.owned_state: Session-local event_seq; canonical events; append-only index
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; duplicate full event payloads in divergent logs; private chain-of-thought persistence
modules.logging_namespace: module-local canonical event records + global event_index
modules.focused_tests: test_event_logging: sequence, hash/index reconstruction and no duplicate payload authority

modules.name: Deadline / Resource Envelope
modules.responsibility: Freeze inferred/explicit task envelope; account reserved invocations/attempts/time before expensive effects
modules.inputs: Frozen deadline/limits; monotonic observed elapsed time; consumed reservations
modules.outputs: Remaining capacity; admitted action or justified terminal
modules.owned_state: Immutable limits and consumed slots within Session
modules.must_not_call: Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence; extend limits silently; infer developer-session time limit; refund unresolved expensive effect
modules.persistent_artifacts: Frozen envelope; reservation/accounting evidence; exhaustion reason
modules.focused_tests: test_adaptive_loop: pre-effect limits and no unresolved refund

modules.name: Model Lifecycle Manager
modules.responsibility: Remain explicitly deferred; represent required/candidate capabilities without acquisition or cleanup effects
modules.inputs: Installed capability inventory; metadata acquisition requirement
modules.outputs: Availability metadata or evidence-backed capability blocker
modules.must_not_call: Model download; model delete/cleanup; cache cleanup; lifecycle daemon; Change frozen Goal, mandatory criteria, or reference authority; resume terminal history; erase prior evidence
modules.focused_tests: Structural audit: no model lifecycle effects
